Full journeys — 6 to 10 days

The Golden Triangle with an extension — Ranthambore for tigers, Udaipur for lakes, Pushkar and Jodhpur for the desert edge. Two nights in most cities.

Tours of this length

Around a week is where India stops being a tour and starts being a trip. Each city gets a full day instead of a morning.

What the price covers

The same on every tour, whatever its length.

Included in every package

  • Private AC car, or train tickets where the tour uses one
  • Hotel pickup and drop
  • Monument tickets booked ahead
  • Ministry-approved local guide
  • Guided monument tour
  • Bottled water
  • Free cancellation up to 24 hours before travel

Not included

  • Personal expenses
